title: Protocol for a Reproducible circRNA Analysis Using Docker4Circ
author: Giulio Ferrero
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.9vmh646
materials: CircRNAs differential expression analysis Before the differential expression analysis of the circRNAs level detected by the circrnaQuantification function, the function mergeData should be applied in order to merge the result obtained for each dataset. # Define a variable storing the list of sample classescov Merge different data The output of this function called MergedData.tsv is a table reporting the counts of each annotation for each dataset. Furthermore, the sample identifiers reported in the header will be report the sample id followed by the corresponding sample class. On this table the differential expression analysis can be perfomed using DESeq2 algorithm implemented in the wrapperDeseq2 function. # Differential expression analysis with DESeq2wrapperDeseq2(group="docker", output.folder=data,experiment.table=paste0(data, "/MergedData.tsv"), log2fc=0, fdr=0.05, ref.covar="N", type="gene", batch=FALSE) Differential expression analysis

steps.title: Install docker4seq R package
steps.instruction: Install and load the docker4seq pipeline in the R environment.

substeps.instruction: Install devtools using install.packages("devtools")
Load devtools using library("devtools")
Install docker4seq from GitHub using install_github("kendomaniac/docker4seq", ref="master")
Load the package using library("docker4seq")

steps.title: Create analysis directories
steps.instruction: Set up the necessary folder structure in the working directory.

substeps.instruction: Create three directories: 'data' (for input/output), 'reference' (for genome and annotation data), and 'scratch' (for temporary data) using system("mkdir data reference scratch")
Verify the working directory path using the getwd() command

steps.title: Download and organize RNA-Seq data
steps.instruction: Download raw RNA-Seq reads for circRNA prediction from PRJNA393626 and organize them into sample-specific folders.

substeps.instruction: Identify required datasets: SRR5889371 (NCM460_rep1), SRR5889366 (NCM460_rep2), SRR5889367 (NCM460_rep3), SRR5889368 (SW480_rep1), SRR5889369 (SW480_rep2), SRR5889362 (SW480_rep3), SRR5889363 (SW620_rep1), SRR5889364 (SW620_rep2), SRR5889365 (SW620_rep3)
Download .fastq files from the ENA page
Create individual folders for each SRA ID within the /data directory using a loop in R

steps.title: Index reference genome with BWA
steps.instruction: Perform BWA indexing of the reference genome using the bwaIndex function, storing the index files in the reference folder.

steps.title: Align reads and predict circRNAs with CIRI2
steps.instruction: Execute quality control, read alignment, and circRNA prediction using the wrapperCiri function.

substeps.instruction: Define paths for the scratch folder and reference genome sequence
Run wrapperCiri to generate fastqc files, BWA alignment files, and predicted circRNAs (.ciri files) within each input fastq folder

steps.title: Merge CIRI2 predictions
steps.instruction: Combine multiple CIRI2 predictions into a single common list using the ciri2MergePredictions function.

substeps.instruction: Copy all .ciri files from dataset folders into the main data folder using system(paste0("cp ", data, "/*/*.ciri ", data))
Define sample groups using a covariate.list vector
Run ciri2MergePredictions to generate 'merged_circRNA.ciri2.count_table' (IDs and coordinates) and 'merged_circRNA.ciri2.txt' (backsplicing read matrix)

steps.title: Index reference genome with STAR
steps.instruction: Perform STAR indexing of the reference genome using the rsemstarIndex function.

substeps.instruction: Execute rsemstarIndex with parameters: group="docker", genome.folder=ref, threads=40, and specified ensembl URLs for genome and GTF

steps.title: Create STARChip reference file
steps.instruction: Generate the required .bed file for the STARChip algorithm using the starChipIndex function.

substeps.instruction: Run starChipIndex(group="docker", genome.folder=ref) to generate 'genome.gtf.bed' and 'genome.gtf.exon.bed' in the reference folder

steps.title: Run STAR chimeric analysis
steps.instruction: Perform STAR chimeric analysis on each RNA-Seq dataset using the starChimeric function.

substeps.instruction: Iterate through dataset IDs and run starChimeric with parameters: group="docker", scratch.folder=scratch, genome.folder=ref, threads=40, chimSegmentMin=20, and chimJunctionOverhangMin=15

steps.title: Predict circRNAs using STARChip
steps.instruction: Predict circRNAs using the starchipCircle_temp function applied to the data folder.

substeps.instruction: Run starchipCircle_temp with parameters: group="docker", genome.folder=ref, scratch.folder=scratch, samples.folder=data, reads.cutoff=1, min.subject.limit=2, threads=40, do.splice=TRUE, cpm.cutoff=0, subjectCPM.cutoff=0, and annotation=TRUE

steps.title: Prepare reference files for classification
steps.instruction: Generate Ensembl exon and transcript annotation files using the circrnaPrepareFiles function.

substeps.instruction: Run circrnaPrepareFiles with group="docker", scratch.folder=scratch, data.folder=data, and assembly="hg19" to create 'exons_reference' and 'isoforms_reference' files

steps.title: Classify circRNAs
steps.instruction: Classify circRNAs into distinct classes based on mapping location using the circrnaClassification function.

substeps.instruction: Run circrnaClassification using the merged_circRNA.ciri2.txt, exons_reference, and isoforms_reference files with assembly="hg19"
Retrieve the resulting 'circRNA_classification' (transcript-level) and 'circRNA_univocal_classification' (gene-level) files

steps.title: Annotate circRNAs from databases
steps.instruction: Annotate circRNAs using public databases (circBase, TSCD, CSCD v2, Circ2Disease, ExoRBase, and CircFunBase) via the circrnaAnnotations function.

substeps.instruction: Run circrnaAnnotations with group="docker", scratch.folder=scratch, ciri.file=merged_circRNA.ciri2.txt, and genome.version="hg19"
Collect the generated .anno files (e.g., circbase.anno)

steps.title: Reconstruct backsplicing junction sequences
steps.instruction: Reconstruct the sequence of the backsplicing junction for each circRNA using the circrnaBSJunctions function.

substeps.instruction: Run circrnaBSJunctions with group="docker", scratch.folder=scratch, circrna.data=merged_circRNA.ciri2.txt, exon.data=exons_reference, and assembly="hg19" to generate 'circRNA_backsplicing_sequences.fasta'

steps.title: Predict alternative splicing events
steps.instruction: Predict alternative splicing events involving circRNAs using the ciriAS function.

substeps.instruction: For each dataset, run ciriAS using the BWA read alignment file (.sam), CIRI2 output (.ciri2), genome file, and annotation file
Retrieve the 'structure.list' and 'structure_AS.list' output files

steps.title: Download quantification RNA-Seq data
steps.instruction: Download RNA-Seq raw reads for circRNA quantification from PRJNA-411984.

substeps.instruction: Identify required datasets: SRR6067723 (CRC_1), SRR6067725 (CRC_2), SRR6067727 (CRC_3), SRR6067729 (Normal mucosa 1), SRR6067731 (Normal mucosa 2), SRR6067733 (Normal mucosa 3)
Organize each dataset into a specific folder within the data directory

steps.title: Quantify circRNA expression
steps.instruction: Compute the quantification of each circRNA in the RNA-Seq datasets using the circrnaQuantification function.

substeps.instruction: Run circrnaQuantification for each dataset using the .fastq file and the 'circRNA_backsplicing_sequences.fasta' file
Retrieve the resulting .hashcirc files containing the number of reads supporting each circRNA
